dataset: WILSY Government Exams - conservative browse catalog
description: A representative overview catalog of major Indian government-exam families for beginner browsing. It is not an official ranking, vacancy list, cutoff guide, or substitute for the recruiting body's current notification; no current eligibility notification has been verified for these family overviews.
classificationNote: Exam categories, family labels, powerLevel, prestigeTier and competition are subjective WILSY editorial browse classifications, not official classifications, merit lists, measured difficulty or appointment outcomes.
stateFamilyNote: APPSC and TGPSC group labels are state-specific family overviews and are not equivalent across states; compatible TSPSC IDs remain only for existing links or saved views.
powerNote: powerLevel uses 1 for the highest typical authority or seniority and 5 for entry-level routes. It is a subjective WILSY editorial label, not an official power, grade, status or service ranking.
tierNote: prestigeTier is a WILSY browsing band for orientation only. It is not an official prestige, selection, difficulty or vacancy ranking.
competitionNote: competition is a subjective WILSY editorial label based on broad public perception, not a measured competition index or official statistic.
eligibilityNote: The shortlist matcher uses independent education branches, broad qualification signals and approximate age information. Read the live official notice for subjects, streams, attempts, domicile, reservation, relaxation, experience, medical standards and all other conditions.

ranking.label: WILSY browse bands
ranking.note: Use these subjective editorial bands to orient a browse, never to infer an official rank or appointment outcome. Lower powerLevel numbers indicate the higher editorial band.

qualification.label: Minimum qualification
qualification.note: The qualification label is representative; the notice controls the exact degree, subject and stream requirement.

eligibility.label: Shortlist check
eligibility.note: A match is a starting shortlist only and is never a legal eligibility decision. State is a target-recruitment browse filter, not a domicile check.

official.label: Official source first
official.note: Open the official hub and active notification before studying for or applying to a cycle.

exams.name: Union Public Service Commission Civil Services Examination
exams.eligibilityText: A recognised university degree is the broad route; exact degree, final-year and service preferences are notice-specific.
exams.ageText: Usually an early-career adult age band with a representative upper age near 32; confirm the cycle notice and reference date.
exams.relaxationText: Upper-age and attempt relaxations can apply to reserved categories and specified groups under the live notice.
exams.patternText: Objective screening is followed by descriptive papers and an interview for the final service allocation.
exams.salaryText: Service and post pay levels, allowances and benefits follow the applicable central pay rules and the official offer.
exams.careerText: A route into service allocation that can include All India Services such as IAS and IPS, central Group A services such as IFS (Foreign), some Group B services and other allied roles; IFoS is separately notified through its own service route.
exams.sourceNote: Official UPSC examination hub exposes examination, cutoff and previous-paper resources; open the active CSE notification and detailed notice before relying on this summary.

exams.ageText: A notice-specific adult age band applies; use the exact date-of-birth window in the active GDS notification.
exams.relaxationText: Category, local-language, rural service and other relaxations follow the active India Post notification.
stages: Merit preparation under the official rules
exams.patternText: Selection is commonly based on notified academic merit and verification rather than a broad written exam.
exams.salaryText: GDS allowance or engagement terms follow the Department of Posts notification; do not treat it as a standard permanent pay level without checking.
exams.careerText: GDS is a Department of Posts engagement category for branch-post, delivery, mail, digital-service and community-facing work within an allotted circle; it is not by itself a regular civil-service appointment.
exams.sourceNote: Official India Post GDS portal; verify circle, language, merit and document conditions in the active notification.
exams.updateNote: Overview only; no current eligibility notification was verified for this exam family. Verify the live official notification before applying; dates, vacancies, eligibility, reservations, relaxations and selection details can change by cycle.
syllabus: Basic computer and postal services awareness where required
exams.previousDataNote: Representative exam-family entry, not a live vacancy or annual notification snapshot.
exams.frequency: Cycle varies; India Post publishes circle-wise notices.

exams.name: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Nursing Officer Recruitment Common Eligibility Test
exams.conductingBody: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi
exams.eligibilityText: B.Sc Nursing, Post-Basic B.Sc Nursing or a permitted nursing diploma with registration is typical; the notice controls.
exams.ageText: A notice-specific nursing-recruitment age band applies; use the exact reference date and institute rules.
exams.relaxationText: Category, registration, experience and institute-specific age relaxations follow the current NORCET notice.
exams.patternText: Nursing knowledge, general aptitude and subject papers are used for common eligibility and institute allocation.
exams.salaryText: Nursing Officer pay level and allowances follow the recruiting institute's official offer and central rules.
exams.careerText: Clinical nursing, ward management, patient care, public-health and specialist-hospital work across participating AIIMS institutions.
exams.sourceNote: Official AIIMS examinations portal; verify nursing registration, institute choices, age and experience conditions.

exams.name: State Civil Judge or Judicial Service Examination
exams.conductingBody: Respective State Public Service Commission or High Court
exams.eligibilityText: A recognised law degree is typical; enrolment and any practice requirement are subject to the current state judicial-service rules and notice.
exams.ageText: State judicial-service age bands vary; use the exact birth-date rules in the relevant state notification.
exams.relaxationText: State reservation, enrolment, practice and category relaxations are notice-specific.
exams.patternText: Law-focused objective and descriptive papers are followed by an interview and state-specific verification.
exams.salaryText: Civil Judge pay and benefits follow the relevant state judicial service rules and recruitment advertisement.
exams.careerText: Entry judicial adjudication, case management and court administration as a state judicial officer after the required training; later progression is governed by the applicable service rules and is not promised here.
exams.sourceNote: Official judiciary service hub; locate the relevant High Court or state commission notice and verify law, enrolment and practice rules.
exams.updateNote: Overview only; no current eligibility notification was verified for this exam family. Verify the live official notification before applying; dates, vacancies, eligibility, reservations, relaxations and selection details can change by cycle.
studyResources: Relevant High Court or PSC syllabus

exams.frequency: Cycle varies by state and court; follow the relevant official notice.

exams.relaxationText: State reservation, utility service and category relaxations follow the relevant official advertisement.
stages: Interview or document verification where notified
exams.patternText: Technical discipline papers are combined with aptitude or general studies and post-wise verification.
exams.salaryText: Utility pay scale, allowances and service conditions are employer- and post-specific; verify the active notice.
